description:
Transform diaper duty into a pleasure with the 6-Drawer Changing Table. This versatile piece combines the convenience of a dedicated changing station with the generous storage of a six-drawer dresser, making it the ultimate nursery workhorse.

Crafted from solid hardwoods and available in a rich Brown Maple finish, this changing table is built to last through multiple children and beyond the diaper years. The spacious flat top accommodates a standard changing pad, giving you a safe, comfortable surface for daily care. Below, six smooth-gliding drawers with sturdy construction provide organized storage for onesies, sleepers, blankets, diapers, wipes, and everything else your little one needs.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
